EMISSION-FACTOR REFERENCE, NOT A TECHNOLOGY SOURCE (reference source; the coordinator decides where it is registered). Excel workbook (5 sheets) of carbon emission factors (CEF), CO2 factors and gross/net calorific values from the 2012 UK GHG National Inventory Report (2010 inventory year; regional natural gas for 2011), for EU ETS tier 2/2b reporting. In _factors.csv (locator = sheet and Excel row): every fuel row of "Emission Factors & CVs" by IPCC sector and industry - CO2 EF on a gross physical basis (kt/Mt fuel, or kt/Mtherm for gases), CO2 t/TJ net, and GCV (with NCV and gross-to-net factor in the note; rows with gas = energy-content are calorific values) - and all LDZ rows of "Regional Natural Gas Data 2011". Oxidation factors are already applied. Not loaded: the postcode-to-LDZ sheet and the unburnt-carbon sheet (in notes). No technology data. TRAPS: natural gas rows say "not applicable to EUETS reporting - see Regional Natural Gas Data"; biomass row has "Various" NCV; blast furnace gas GCV = NCV.
